decision.reason: No impact and stable vitals; CV anomaly dismissed.

events.title: Voice verification started
events.detail: A fall has been detected. Are you okay?

events.title: Emergency tier_1_verify
events.detail: Fall-like posture without impact; verifying verbally.

scenarios.label: Resting
scenarios.description: Quiet baseline: HR ~72 BPM, gravity-only accelerometer. Nothing should escalate.

scenarios.label: Standard fall
scenarios.description: PRD scenario A: impact spike at t=5s, then stillness with a panic HR climb.

scenarios.label: Seizure
scenarios.description: PRD scenario B: hard impact at t=5s, 5 Hz tremor, HR climbing past 130 BPM.

scenarios.label: Syncope
scenarios.description: PRD scenario C: soft collapse at t=5s, bradycardia, then the pulse disappears.

scenarios.label: Syncope → seizure
scenarios.description: rest 0–8s, PPG drop 8–12s, collapse 12s, pulse lost 14–19s, seizure from 19s

scenarios.label: Trip fall
scenarios.description: gait 7–10s, trip/impact 10.3s, scramble, then still (panic HR, not seizure)

scenarios.label: Night syncope
scenarios.description: sit 0–8s, stand-up 8s, orthostatic HR drop, crumple 11s, pulse lost 16s

scenarios.label: Tonic-clonic
scenarios.description: aura 6–11s (HR climb), drop 11s, clonic 5 Hz from 11.2s

scenarios.label: Silent slump
scenarios.description: sit 0–8s, fidget, slow chair-slide 14s, no hard impact
